comparison.objective: Retrieve an out-of-reach jar by pulling its support board, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Use a movable support as an indirect reach aid, then pick and place a jar; no locking fastener, collar, or test-fixture operation.
comparison.success_condition: Jar released and still in the basket without falling; no dynamic carriage or force limits.
comparison.reason: Indirect retrieval and placement are unrelated to commissioning a mechanical energy absorber.
